meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接、脚本或简介变成可发布的产品发布宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把产品或活动快速做成一支能直接发布的宣传短片
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link, script, or brief into a publishable product launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a ready-to-publish promo clip for a product or launch

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或简述，转成产品发布/推广视频：捕获素材、选设计系统、写分镜与脚本、逐帧生成，最后渲染出 video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你想推广、发布或揭晓某个产品时触发；商业网址默认走这条路，网站巡览或展示也算；意图不明时先读 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把 acme.com 做成一段产品发布视频
say.note: 会先抓取该网站，再规划并逐帧搭建

say.text: 这是我的产品脚本，做成推广视频
say.note: 脚本原样存下，然后写分镜和旁白

say.text: 给我们公司做一个产品揭晓视频
say.note: 从简述出发，无需抓取网站

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch/promo video: captures assets, picks a design system, writes a storyboard and script, builds frames, and renders video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, or reveal a product; a commercial URL routes here by default, and site tours or showcases stay here too. Unclear intent reads /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn acme.com into a product launch video.
say_en.note: Captures the site, then plans and builds the frames.

say_en.text: Here is my product script — make it a promo video.
say_en.note: Saves it verbatim, then writes the storyboard.

say_en.text: Make a product reveal video for our company.
say_en.note: Starts from a brief, no site capture needed.
